title: Closed-Loop Cognitive Cycle Contract
description: Request and response payload contracts for `sekha-cluster-tool orchestrate` (>= v1.0.12), which coordinates all four stages in a single closed-loop turn. stdout always carries exactly one JSON object: `response` on exit code 0 (completed) or 2 (partial or failed cycle), `error_response` on exit code 1 (the cycle never ran). Diagnostics go to stderr. The default response is concise (about 2-3 KB for any input up to the 1 MiB cap); `--full` restores the full nested stage payloads for operator debugging only. Property names mirror the compiled tool's JSON tags exactly and must never be anglicised.

StageTelemetry.description: Outcome and duration of one stage of the cognitive loop.

status.description: Stage outcome. `over_budget` applies to stage 3 only: it ran, but the prompt was over the Node 2 context budget.

error.description: Error detail, present only on failure; capped at about 300 bytes. A deadline error names the value used and where it came from.

CountSummary.description: Count-only stage summary in the default output. It carries no chunk text, recalled node list, or per-node gate decisions; those appear only with `--full`.

request.description: Configuration for a full cognitive turn. Populated from the CLI flags --input (repeatable), --directive, --trace-id, --max-tokens and --sync. Stage deadlines come from --sensory-timeout, --timeout (recall only on this subcommand) and --consolidate-timeout, or their CLUSTER_*_TIMEOUT_MS settings.

raw_input.description: The raw sensory stream to process (CLI flag --input).

task_directive.description: Attention and reasoning directive for the turn (CLI flag --directive).

max_tokens.description: Generation budget for Stage 3 deliberation. Each token widens the Stage 3 deadline by 100 ms.

session_id.description: Session identifier threaded through the turn.

synchronous_consolidate.description: When true (CLI flag --sync), block on Stage 4 consolidation statistics.

response.description: Concise end-to-end outcome of the four-stage cycle (exit code 0 or 2). A cycle succeeded only when status is `completed`, loop_complete is true and the exit code is 0.

status.description: `completed` when no stage failed, `partial` when some failed, `failed` when all failed.

is_complete.description: Node 2's own deliberation flag. It does NOT mean the loop completed; use loop_complete for that.

proposed_action.description: The action proposed at the end of the turn.

trace_id.description: Distributed trace identifier for the whole turn.

loop_complete.description: True only when all four stages report `success`.

recall.description: Count-only Stage 2 summary, including relevance_gate counts.

error_response.description: Printed with exit code 1 when the cycle never ran. Report `error` as a configuration or invocation problem.
